_comment: Pinned model files for B1 (P3) and the engine (P5). Fetched by scripts/fetch_models.py into models/ (never committed) and checked against sha256. Revisions and hashes from the Hugging Face API (metadata only), 14 Oct 2026. See docs/MODELS.md. Fine-tuned models (P4) have no Hugging Face repo: their file comes from the private Kaggle run (docs/TRAINING.md), `run` points to its train/runs/ file, and `prompt` is the exact rendered prompt the engine uses (ADR 0017/0018).

models.publisher: Unsloth (conversion of Qwen's official weights; Qwen publishes only Q8_0 GGUF for Qwen3)
bartowski (conversion of Google's weights; the Gemma Terms of Use still apply)
bartowski (conversion of Meta's weights; the Llama 3.2 Community License still applies)
this project: LoRA fine-tune of Llama 3.2 1B Instruct on Kaggle (ADR 0015); weights not in the repo (808 MB), may be published (ADR 0028)
